_comment: health-band checks. Feeds: newest bar (bar start + bar_minutes) must be within max_stale_market_min CME Globex minutes (Sun 18:00 -> Fri 17:00 ET, daily halt 17:00-18:00 ET; exchange holidays not modelled). ts: a column name, or 'index' for the parquet's index. forward_pane: the forward-pane collector reused for stale jobs. Gauges (always drawn): lse_calls_log lines dated today (local) out of lse_daily_limit; agent_logs = dispatch.sh logs started today or still running; profile_script's `measure` desc_chars plus user_skills descriptions, /4 = tokens per turn. watchdog: scheduled_tasks_glob = the desktop app's scheduled-tasks.json (a cron task whose lastRunAt is older than its latest due time, 15 min grace, is red; the app keeps no per-run status so failed runs are not visible); watchdog_regex = launchd labels checked for non-zero exit / missed runs, minus label_regex (the forward pane covers those); success_markers = a file whose mtime is the job's last success (max_age_hours); known_issues = label -> text, shown as one amber row instead of red while the job is unhealthy. creds.py: backup = newest `backed up` stamp in the log (red past max_age_hours, with the last .err line and the known_issues text for com.autorank.backup as the fix; that label is in skip_labels so the watchdog does not repeat it); oauth_token = the headless token file is only stat()ed (missing/empty red; red/amber from file age against an ASSUMED valid_days, warn_days before) and scan_logs (modified within 24 h) are scanned for auth-rejection text; youtube = token.json missing amber, invalid_grant/RefreshError in the log within 48 h red, token older than 6 days with no logged upload amber. lse-gone: a 410 / 'new documentation' line in a job log or extra_logs (stamped lines must be inside log_window_hours) is one red cause row listing the logs in `affects`; forward job rows with a 410 in their error text are folded into it. extra_logs = logs outside the plists' StandardOut/Err (restart/out_live/run.log is already livepractice's StandardOut, so it is not repeated here). Every log check ignores stamped lines older than log_window_hours. data_flow (dataflow.py): kinds mtime_glob | parquet_ts | json_field | log_match; limit max_lag_business_days (Mon-Fri days after the source date; weekends skipped, holidays not modelled) or max_lag_days (calendar). Paths verified on disk 2026-10-29: livepractice = data/live/*_live.parquet written by live_fetch.py (it refuses data older than 3 business days itself; out_live/*.parquet are derived caches); ticks = newest bar of of_NQ.F_1m.parquet, weekly Monday job so 10 days; oftick = status.json `updated` (ledger.csv only changes on trades); claude4b = `context build failed` in plans/run.log within 48 h.

known_issues.com.example.youtube-automation: not loaded, awaiting YouTube Google OAuth (reminders.md)
known_issues.com.autorank.backup: grant Full Disk Access to /bin/bash for launchd, or move the target off iCloud (reminders.md)
